Co-firing of IZ pairs in replication-progress bins

Source: R/izone_adjacency.R
summarise_pair_cofiring_bins.Rd

An IZ is fired in a cell when one of the cell's tracks is assigned to it (iz_id). Cells are grouped into bin_num equal bins of rep_percent (cells without rep_percent form one NA bin); per pair and bin the numbers of cells with the left / right IZ fired are summed, and per pair the bins are classified by which members fired at least once.

Usage

summarise_pair_cofiring_bins(pairs, tracks, meta_data, bin_num = 100L)

Arguments

pairs

Output of make_pair_init().

tracks

Named GRangesList of tracks with an iz_id column (e.g. define_initiation_zones()$tracks).

meta_data

A data.frame with columns cell_id and rep_percent.

bin_num

Number of rep_percent bins.

Value

A list with pair_bins (per pair and bin: bin_mid, median rep_percent, summed left_iz_state / right_iz_state) and pair_fired_info (per pair: numbers of bins with neither / only left / only right / both fired, n_all and the corresponding rates).
